# Hyrinx Rental (hyrinx.in) — Entity Reference & Knowledge Specification

> Hyrinx is India's premier website renting and temporary developer platform, allowing users, event hosts, student organizers, and businesses to rent ready-to-launch website templates by the day, week, or month instead of investing in expensive permanent custom development.

## Core Positioning & Entity Facts
- **Brand Name:** Hyrinx / Hyrinx Rental
- **Domain:** https://hyrinx.in
- **Founders:** Rahul Sisode (Founder & CEO), Harshal (Founder & Creative Strategist)
- **Headquarters / Country:** India
- **Contact:** hyrinxofficial@gmail.com | Phone/WhatsApp: +91-9730213645
- **Pricing:** Starting at ₹149/day. Packages: 1 Day (₹149), 3 Days (₹399), 7 Days (₹599), 15 Days (₹799), 1 Month (₹1099), 3 Months (₹2099), 6 Months (₹3599), 1 Year (₹6099).
- **Turnaround Time:** Standard templates go live in 2 to 6 hours. Custom websites in 24 to 48 hours.
- **Included with Every Rental:** Cloud hosting, custom subdomain or custom domain DNS mapping, mobile responsiveness, personalization of names/dates/photos/colors, 24/7 technical support, WhatsApp RSVP integrations.

## Template Categories
1. **Wedding Invitations:** Luxury royal Indian wedding invitations with 3D wax-sealed patrika, 7 sacred vows (Saat Phere), couple love story timeline, shehnai audio player, and WhatsApp RSVP (e.g. Royal Wedding, Eternal Moments, Royal Union).
2. **College Fests & Techfests:** Registration portals, sports/cultural/technical event matrix, hackathon showcases, participant passes (e.g. College Fest Pro, HackSprint TechFest).
3. **Projects for College Students:** Final-year engineering capstone demos with verified source code, architecture diagrams, and viva Q&A guidance (e.g. AI Phishing Detection, Scalnex SaaS, Password Security Analyzer, Aptitude Platform, Voice Assistant).
4. **Local Business & Food:** Cafes, bistros, gyms, salons, real estate, coaching academies (e.g. Gourmet Bistro & Cafe, IronPulse Gym, Luxe Salon & Spa).
5. **Birthdays & Celebrations:** Milestone birthdays with countdown timers, silver jubilee anniversaries, baby showers (e.g. Birthday Bash, Silver Jubilee, Little Miracle).
6. **Portfolios & Freelance:** Creative portfolios for photographers, freelance developers, and consultants (e.g. ShutterCraft Studio, DevCraft Freelance).
